setting.name: fusionSettingFormat
setting.description: The format of this settings file. Change it and the next compile writes the settings in the new format and keeps the old file as a backup (.bak) - only one settings file is active

setting.name: tab_width
setting.description: How many spaces a tab counts as

setting.name: allow_mixed
setting.description: Allow tabs and spaces mixed in one file's indentation

section.name: source
section.description: What the source text may contain

setting.name: allow_unicode_identifiers
setting.description: Allow letters beyond ASCII in names (a security risk: look-alike letters)

setting.name: max_nesting_depth
setting.description: How deeply structs may hold structs (1 = no struct inside another)

setting.name: warn_nesting_depth
setting.description: Warn from this depth (0 = never warn)

setting.name: string_storage
setting.description: How a string field holds its text

setting.name: string_mutable
setting.description: A string field can be changed after the struct is made

setting.name: string_warn_length
setting.description: Warn when a string field's text is longer than this (0 = never warn)

setting.name: max_length
setting.description: The longest a string may be, in characters - longer is an error, never cut

setting.name: encoding
setting.description: How text is stored

setting.name: layer
setting.description: std: everything; alloc: no operating system (no print, files); core: no memory allocation

setting.name: returns
setting.description: Error returns: T, Error function and capturing T x, err = f()

setting.name: exceptions
setting.description: try / catch / finally / throw

setting.name: auto_widening
setting.description: An int used as a float widens automatically (with a warning); false: it must fit exactly

setting.name: variables
setting.description: Module-level variables (module constants are always allowed)

setting.name: numbers
setting.description: A number as a condition - positive: above zero is true; nonzero: not zero is true (C, Python); off: a condition must be a bool

setting.name: mode
setting.description: normal; strict; unsafe (whole-number arithmetic wraps around)

setting.name: max_call_depth
setting.description: How deep calls may go; max: endless recursion is caught by stack use alone

setting.name: target
setting.description: c: C compiled by GCC
